blocks.x: Trying the most historic Full English Breakfast in London at E. Pellicci with @GaryEats! 🍳 This legendary, family-run East London cafe in Bethnal Green has been serving classic British fry-ups since 1900. Loaded with sausages, eggs, crispy bacon, beans, fried bread, and unmatched local hospitality, is this the ultimate breakfast in the UK? #London #Foodie #breakfast
